visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). The index.html in this directory is the RETIRED KB-era mockup and is kept only because ci:mockup-coverage requires a parity.json beside any index.html. It is not the visual target for this route any more. The target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3, plus the listing-detail money stack which is outside the five public-ui registers.
competitiveTarget: Zillow Showcase + Hilton & Hyland editorial register (per docs/research/top-brokerage-listing-content-audit.md)
note: Migrated off the KB chrome onto the v3 barrel 2026-08-13 (E-HOMES-DETAIL). Rhythm: three of the six patterns (Sheet inside the listing stack, Ledger, Quiet), no two adjacent alike, chrome exempt. Order is Breadcrumb, listing-detail stack (hero, price, facts, remarks, Sheet alerts, restyle, map, market, schools, parks, history, money, attribution), Ledger (similar homes), Quiet (edges), Footer. PUBLIC_UI.md section 1: the page primary at 390 is PriceCtaStrip filled Schedule a tour. Valuation is a Quiet link labeled Value my home. V3Footer carries no button. Layout owns V3Chrome. One V3Footer outside main. No kb-root.

dataChanges.unchanged: Every listing figure, filter, window, and unit. getListingDetail, photos, videos, history, open houses, pulse, brokers, reviews, published CMA, related homes. JSON-LD RealEstateListing + BreadcrumbList still emit from the page MetadataBlock with listingDetailPath, listingShareSummary, gated photos slice 0-5, and ctaBroker as listingAgent. MLS publicRemarks are displayed, never rewritten. Capture still calls submitSearchAlertSignup with city, propertyType A, price band, beds when present, field email, trap company.
dataChanges.similarHomes: KbFeatured video tiles are deleted. Similar homes render as V3Ledger figure rows from relatedHomes.primary. Rows without a street or a list price are dropped (v3Text throws on blank; formatPrice of null is not a price). formatPrice rounding to $1,000 is display-only on the Ledger. JSON-LD still uses the raw listPrice.
dataChanges.builderTiles: getListingsByBuilder is deleted from this page. The builder door in Quiet opens /builders/<slug>. That route still owns the builder inventory rail.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics, pageType='listing'. Kept on the KB register deliberately: section tracking is analytics wiring, not visual language, and the barrel ships no equivalent.
